genericProblem: A login response that represents a selectable or empty identity state is collapsed into a shell session before a selected assignment exists, leaving navigation and actions permanently unavailable.

counterexamples.evidence: A selected assignment yields page keys and action grants that can enter the shell.
The login consumer previously converted absent selected into an empty shell session and offered no assignment selector.
The shell cannot create a selected assignment for an account with no candidate.

findings.genericProblem: Session outcomes must be preserved until required assignment selection completes.
No-candidate authentication needs an explicit terminal user state rather than a disabled shell.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: generated WorkspaceSessionEntry mode/outcome consumer plus CR06 closure ledger
